Kill 4 [[Stygian Lord]]s.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill 4 Stygian Lords in the [[Stygian Veil]].
* *BONUS* Kill 4 Stygian Lords in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
*10,000 [[Experience]]
*1,500 [[Gold]]
*500 [[Lightbringer Points]]
*Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
*Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
See [[Breaching the Stygian Veil]] and [[Brood Wars]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zaishen Combat
:''"Kill 4 Stygian Lords in the Stygian Veil."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!

Heroes who are up to the challenge should seek this fiend out, taking blood as payment for a life of atrocious deeds.}} {{sic|Unlike 'Harn and Maxine Coldstone (Zaishen quest)' and 'The Four Horsemen (Zaishen quest)', this dialogue uses singular terms instead of plural.}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''
